title: Risk Scores
description:
Risk Scores computes validated clinical risk scores across an OMOP CDM cohort — including the Charlson Comorbidity Index, Elixhauser, CHA₂DS₂-VASc, HAS-BLED, and APACHE. Pick a cohort and a score definition, confirm the OMOP concept sets that supply each clinical input, then run a batch calculation that writes per-patient scores and population-level distributions.

The Hub lists every analysis run with its status and source. Open a run to see the score histogram, risk-band stratification, and per-patient detail. Use **Create** to configure a new run.
tips: Each score declares the OMOP domains it needs (conditions, drugs, measurements, demographics) — confirm the source has those domains populated before running.
CHA₂DS₂-VASc and HAS-BLED are intended for atrial-fibrillation populations; restrict the cohort accordingly for clinically meaningful results.
The Charlson and Elixhauser indices rely on ICD/SNOMED condition mappings — review the bundled concept sets if your source uses an unusual vocabulary.
Risk-band thresholds follow published guidelines; the detail view lets you re-stratify with custom cut points.
Scores are computed against the cohort snapshot at run time, not live — re-run after regenerating the cohort.
Large cohorts run as background jobs; track progress on the Jobs page and open the run when it completes.
